note: OpenViking is NOT vendored as source. It is installed from PyPI into a venv by scripts/openviking-setup.sh, which refuses a wheel whose sha256 differs from the row below and installs the whole dependency closure with pip --require-hashes from requirements-macos-arm64-py311.lock (163 packages, resolved 2026-09-27 by `uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 --python-platform aarch64-apple-darwin` from `openviking==0.4.21`). Only LICENSE is upstream bytes here (from the wheel's openviking-0.4.21.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE; byte-identical to LICENSE at upstream main a09a9d2). Measured install on macOS arm64, Python 3.11: 1.2 GB venv, 165 distributions. It runs as a separate local HTTP server; Kira reaches it over 127.0.0.1 only through plugins/aukora-kira/lib/recall-openviking.mjs.

embeddingModel.why: OpenViking needs an embedding model. This one runs on the Mac through llama.cpp's llama-server (OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings), so no note text leaves the machine and no API key is needed. OpenViking's own `local` provider supports only bge-small-zh-v1.5 (a Chinese model), which is why it is not used.
embeddingModel.license: Apache-2.0 (model card; the model is not vendored)
embeddingModel.server: llama-server from llama.cpp (Homebrew `llama.cpp`), NOT pinned by this manifest

genesisAuthored.why: This manifest. A file cannot carry its own digest; the pin checker prints it instead.
Genesis-authored notice: what OpenViking is, its licence and holder, and that it is installed rather than vendored.
Generated hash lock of the dependency closure (see note). Its sha256 is recorded under `lock` and checked by scripts/openviking-setup.sh before it is used.
